description: Renovate keeps ONLY the sha256-pinned release downloads in the workflows current (gitleaks,
actionlint, the Codacy coverage reporter), which Dependabot cannot see. Everything else stays
with Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml), so the two never propose the same update.
Each pin is marked in its step's env with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=owner/repo`
line directly above the VERSION (the release tag) and SHA256 lines. The
github-release-attachments datasource finds the asset the current sha256 belongs to and
proposes the new tag together with that asset's new sha256. tests/unit/part19.py gates that

customManagers.description: Workflow release downloads pinned by tag and sha256
